leftEvidence.title: Humanity receives image, blessing, and rule

points.label: Human place
points.left: Humanity is created near the end of the ordered sequence.
points.right: Humanity is considered beneath moon and stars in a psalm of wonder.

points.label: Rule
points.left: Humans are commanded to rule over living creatures.
points.right: Humans are described as placed over the works of God’s hands.

points.label: Tone
points.left: The language is commission and blessing.
points.right: The language is astonishment at divine attention and honor.

payload.posture: Notice what Psalm 8 keeps from Genesis and what changes when the same human role is expressed as wonder.

rightEvidence.title: Human significance becomes a question beneath the heavens

payload.tension: Genesis commissions humanity within creation, while Psalm 8 turns the same small-yet-honored place into a question of wonder.
payload.title: Commission / wonder
